sections.description: Browser-saved product collections with branded email and optional newsletter consent.
sections.changelog:
= 0.6.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 0.6.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 0.6.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 0.2.21 =
* Keep collection controls ready when script optimizers load assets before the page body.

= 0.2.20 =
* Keep existing saved-list storage intact when reactivating Collections.

= 0.2.19 =
* Consolidate the approved CLJ staging refinements: editable email copy, cached collection loading, launcher artwork and visible browser-storage guidance.
* Preserve adjustable product hearts and visible keyboard focus with a 44 × 44 px target.

= 0.2.18 =
* Keep the short header reminder and restore the dropdown explaining browser storage and emailing a copy.
* Edit both header messages, the dropdown label and its explanation in Collection guidance settings.

= 0.2.17 =
* Keep the browser-save reminder visible beside the collection email controls, above the saved finds.

= 0.2.16 =
* Refine the illustrated Christmas scroll with aged brass holders, handwritten ink and a natural lower roll.

= 0.2.15 =
* Restore the richer antique scroll artwork with opposing curls, blank parchment and bottom-left holly.

= 0.2.14 =
* Upload a custom PNG or WebP floating icon through the Media Library, with replace, remove and draft preview controls.
* Simplify the illustrated scroll with opposing curls, blank parchment and bottom-left holly clear of the count badge.

= 0.2.13 =
* Clarify editable post title text for Save Post and Share Post, with guidance for dynamic titles and custom wording.
* Use a clearly labeled example title in email previews and explain shared footer overrides.

= 0.2.12 =
* Choose an illustrated Christmas parchment scroll for the floating button, inside the circle or on its own.

= 0.2.11 =
* Give Email branding a wider workspace and a full-size desktop preview.
* Refine email controls, branding groups and the responsive preview toolbar.

= 0.2.10 =
* Choose a heart or three Christmas scroll designs for the floating Collections button.
* Display the floating icon inside a circle or on its own, with a draft preview in settings.

= 0.2.9 =
* Edit subject, headings, introductions, buttons and other text separately for every email type, with draft previews.
* Keep Save Post and Share Post together in the email editor.

= 0.2.8 =
* Prepare saved finds before opening Collections and reuse recent display details across pages in the same tab.
* Show ready cards immediately while missing items load, preserving existing cards and keyboard focus.
* Warm the first visible product images with bounded, low-priority background work.

= 0.2.7 =
* Load saved finds without an extra session request when the page token is current.
* Replace loading cards correctly when saving new finds after emptying a collection.

= 0.2.6 =
* Prevent a repeated Remove click from selecting text that moves beneath the removed card.

= 0.2.5 =
* Prevent text highlighting when repeatedly clicking Remove while keeping keyboard focus visible.

= 0.2.4 =
* Show installed plugin details and release notes when the release service is unavailable.

= 0.2.3 =
* Match Attentive setup to the branded Save to Email connection controls.
* Choose email logos from the WordPress Media Library with replace/remove controls.

= 0.2.2 =
* Keep separators between shop items and remove the final item’s border above the email footer.

= 0.2.1 =
* Show one introduction when sharing a post: sender attribution when named, otherwise the generic introduction.

= 0.2.0 =
* Add private usage analytics with bounded daily totals for favorites, collections and post emails.
* Organize settings into MTT-styled tabs with native controls and draft email previews.

= 0.1.26 =
* Bring all collection and post emails closer to CLJ’s website with serif typography, warm paper, fine frames and square buttons.
* Make Saved for Later the prominent heading above the post title.

= 0.1.25 =
* Include the bordered featured image when sharing a post by email.

= 0.1.24 =
* Place Saved for Later above the post title in personal saved-post emails.

= 0.1.23 =
* Include the featured image in personal saved-post emails with a padded border and a Read the post button.

= 0.1.22 =
* Separate post sharing by email from saving a post for later with a bookmark icon.

= 0.1.20 =
* Match the post email popup heading, introduction and button to the save prompt.

= 0.1.19 =
* Give post and wishlist opt-in checkboxes separate editable wording.
* Restore the post email button wording.

= 0.1.18 =
* Give the post email popup its own introduction and send button wording.

= 0.1.17 =
* Remove the decorative mail icon from email dialogs.

= 0.1.16 =
* Restore the email icon and let themes share their native artwork across mail controls and dialogs.

= 0.1.15 =
* Remove the decorative divider from email dialogs.

= 0.1.14 =
* Open email forms at their complete size while preparing the collection.
* Preserve unfinished form entries and prevent sending before preparation completes.

= 0.1.13 =
* Replace the decorative envelope in email dialogs with a simple brand-colored divider.

= 0.1.12 =
* Remove the collection count summary from email forms.

= 0.1.11 =
* Show only the number of finds in collection email form summaries.

= 0.1.10 =
* Let the collection header scroll on phones while keeping the close button reachable.

= 0.1.9 =
* Keep the intro, collection count and email/share actions visible with the modal heading.

= 0.1.8 =
* Keep the collection heading and close button visible while saved finds scroll.

= 0.1.7 =
* Display encoded punctuation and ampersands correctly in collection titles, brands and emails.

= 0.1.6 =
* Show collection progress and the next batch size; reveal older finds without replacing loaded cards.

= 0.1.5 =
* Add an editable email newsletter checkbox default; sharing always excludes newsletter signup.

= 0.1.4 =
* Shorten collection and email copy to match CLJ’s voice.

= 0.1.3 =
* Show newest saved finds first across collection views and emails.

= 0.1.2 =
* Add optional sender name, reply-to email and a personal message when sharing a collection.

= 0.1.1 =
* Smooth first collection opening with reserved card space and softly revealed images; keep loaded cards when reopening.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add guest product collections, accessible hearts and shared modal/page views.
* Add branded list/post email, optional Attentive consent and expiring large-list sharing.

* Refine CLJ collection pages, mobile dialogs and email forms; keep newsletter signup unchecked.
* Add floating-heart placement controls, animated dialog opening and click-outside dismissal.
